values.note: 9 full-hookup sites on concrete pads beside an asphalt lot, and 12 primitive electric-only sites.

sites.source: https://www.routtcountyfair.org/p/other/campingrv-park ('9 full-hook up ... sites with concrete pads and an asphalt parking lot'; '12 primitive electric-only (20amp) sites'), read 2026-10-27. The page states no rig length, so the derived 50 ft (from note prose) is cleared.

values.note: Bath house open year-round with coin-operated showers. Dump station $7.50 a use.

facilities.source: https://www.routtcountyfair.org/p/other/campingrv-park ('The bath house is available year round, with coin operated showers'; 'Dump Station: $7.50 per use'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Full-hookup sites open year-round (heated hoses recommended in winter); the primitive electric sites April 15 to November 30. No public camping August 1-31, during the Routt County Fair.

season.source: https://www.routtcountyfair.org/p/other/campingrv-park ('Full-hook up sites are open year-round. values.note: Reserve online through the county's Adventure Central page; every guest must also submit a completed rental agreement or the reservation is cancelled. 14 days at most in any 30 per RV; no long-term camping.

booking.source: https://www.routtcountyfair.org/p/other/campingrv-park ('RESERVE YOUR RV CAMPING SPOT HERE!' linking to adventurecentral.com; 'ALL guests MUST submit a completed rental agreement or reservation will be terminated'; 'Routt County allows for a fourteen (14) day maximum reservation within a 30 day period per RV. No long term camping is available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Full hookups $48 a day, primitive 20-amp electric $28, plus taxes and fees. Dump station $7.50 a use.

fees.source: https://www.routtcountyfair.org/p/other/campingrv-park ('Full Hook- Up Sites: (water, sewer, and electric 20/30/50 ) are $48.00/day plus taxes and fees.'; 'Primitive Electric Sites: (20 amp) are $28.00/day plus taxes and fees.'; footer 'Copyright ©2026'), read 2026-10-27

note: Routt County-operated RV park at the county fairgrounds in Hayden, opened April 2018. --Claude
